name: 59-google-empty-text-and-empty-tool-calls
description: Two truthiness guards in one call. (1) `hasToolCalls` requires `tool_calls.length > 0` (:472), so an EMPTY tool_calls array does not produce a tool_calls part -- the turn stays a plain text part and its content survives. (2) The merge branch tests `if (part.text)` (:602), so a text part whose text is the empty string is neither appended to the previous text part nor caught by the second guard at :610, and that turn vanishes from the merged contents without a trace. Expected: contents = [{'role':'user','parts':[{'text':'Hello\n\nstill text'}]}] -- three input turns in, one part out.
